production_scope: Explicit named equality predicates replace literal bindings; SQL/head/date conditions unchanged, H05 order advisory retained. No compiler/storage/transfer implementation fix applied.

verification.sf0_1_and_sf1: Exact against existing unchanged-SQL DuckDB witnesses; independent operator/build counts checked.

method: Current production compiler and storage. Fresh literal-form controls and production predicate forms; one warmup, five uninstrumented measurements, build/typed result collection included. Separate profiles; do not add overlapping profile spans or subtract them from plain timings. Diagnostic absorption uses existing checked cq_elaborate::simplify_reductions followed by cq_planners_plan::check; not a production change.

findings.finding: Predicate forms change physical representation, including projected membership and positional selections; they are not cosmetic.

CQ Transfer skips existing reduction absorption. Applying that checked pass in temporary workers removes the observed transfer regressions relative to predicate-form defaults on all four tested kernels. It prunes backward support versions, restores useful scan filters, and lets fact intermediates remain pipes.

Predicate D27 Transfer turns one fused fact stream into Selection::select followed by two narrow calls, including temporary snapshots for Physical pipe intermediates. Slice hosts expose one block of 6001215 rows. Each narrow walks the full block and initializes a full-sized mask despite sparse survivors.

For 9225->357 narrowing, current enumeration-only control takes 3.079ms versus 0.103ms for existing bitmap-word row enumeration. This is not an end-to-end runtime patch; both controls preserve occurrence-ID count/checksum.

Absorbed plans can record duplicate filters for one scan/build/key with different covering semijoin/probe operators. H08 inserts 182358 order keys into filter construction for a 91179-key build. No deduplication fix applied.

paper_comparison.scope: The measured CQ Transfer uses exact semijoins, a static written-root schedule and ordinary lowering. It is not the paper vectorized Bloom pipeline or RPT+ adaptive execution. Default already uses Masks reductions. Paper RPT explicitly prunes unnecessary transfers/backward work; these regressions should not be attributed to unavoidable algorithmic overhead.

limits: Four derived join kernels, not full standard TPC-H or a proof of global non-regression.
H05 and H07-block are classified cyclic by current graph analysis; D27/H08 acyclic. Hypergraph is not uniformly full Yannakakis for every configuration.
The absorption experiment is temporary and still has duplicate-filter work; the production Transfer path remains unchanged.
